{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_, threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Concurrent.Chan (Chan, newChan, readChan, writeChan)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, void)
import Data.IORef (IORef, newIORef, readIORef, writeIORef, atomicModifyIORef')
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import Data.Char (ord, chr, isAlphaNum, isSpace)

type Headers = Map.Map String String
type MessageQueue = Chan QueueMessage

data QueueMessage = QueueMessage
  { msgTo      :: String
  , msgFrom    :: String
  , msgSubject :: String
  , msgBody    :: String
  , msgCustomHeaders :: Headers
  } deriving (Show)

data ShutdownState = Running | Draining | Stopped
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data ConsumerState = ConsumerState
  { csShutdown   :: IORef ShutdownState
  , csProcessed  :: IORef Int
  , csPendingBuf :: IORef [String]
  }

-- | RFC 5322 compliant header field body sanitizer
-- Removes bare CR/LF that could enable header injection
sanitizeHeaderValue :: String -> String
sanitizeHeaderValue = foldr step []
  where
    step c acc
      | c == '\r' = acc  -- strip CR
      | c == '\n' = acc  -- strip LF
      | otherwise  = c : acc

-- | Encode a structured header field using folding
foldHeader :: String -> String -> String
foldHeader name value =
  let sanitized = sanitizeHeaderValue value
      maxLen = 78 - length name - 2
  in if length sanitized <= maxLen
     then name ++ ": " ++ sanitized
     else name ++ ": " ++ take maxLen sanitized ++ "\r\n " ++ drop maxLen sanitized

-- | Build the full email from a queue message
-- Uses a two-phase approach: first build structured headers, then serialize
buildEmail :: QueueMessage -> String
buildEmail msg = unlines $ headerLines ++ ["", msgBody msg]
  where
    baseHeaders =
      [ ("To", msgTo msg)
      , ("From", msgFrom msg)
      , ("Subject", msgSubject msg)
      , ("MIME-Version", "1.0")
      , ("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
      ]
    customHeaders = Map.toList (msgCustomHeaders msg)
    allHeaders = baseHeaders ++ customHeaders
    headerLines = map (uncurry formatHeaderLine) allHeaders

-- | Format a single header line with proper encoding
-- This function handles the critical boundary between header names and values
formatHeaderLine :: String -> String -> String
formatHeaderLine name value =
  let cleanName = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-') name
      -- Apply sanitization to the value portion
      cleanValue = sanitizeFieldBody value
  in cleanName ++ ": " ++ cleanValue

-- | Sanitize a field body per RFC 5322 Section 2.2
-- Field bodies must not contain bare CRLF except as part of folding
sanitizeFieldBody :: String -> String
sanitizeFieldBody [] = []
sanitizeFieldBody ('\r':'\n':' ':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- CRLF+space -> space (strip folding)
sanitizeFieldBody ('\r':'\n':'\t':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- CRLF+tab -> space (strip folding)
sanitizeFieldBody ('\r':'\n':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- bare CRLF -> space
sanitizeFieldBody ('\r':rest) = sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- bare CR removed
sanitizeFieldBody ('\n':' ':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- LF+space -> space (strip folding)
sanitizeFieldBody ('\n':'\t':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- LF+tab -> space (strip folding)
sanitizeFieldBody ('\n':rest) = ' ' : sanitizeFieldBody rest  -- bare LF -> space
sanitizeFieldBody (c:rest) = c : sanitizeFieldBody rest

-- | Process a single message from the queue
processMessage :: ConsumerState -> QueueMessage -> IO ()
processMessage cs msg = do
  state <- readIORef (csShutdown cs)
  case state of
    Stopped -> return ()
    _ -> do
      let email = buildEmail msg
      -- In production this would call sendmail or SMTP
      appendToBuffer cs email
      atomicModifyIORef' (csProcessed cs) (\n -> (n + 1, ()))

-- | Append rendered email to the pending send buffer
appendToBuffer :: ConsumerState -> String -> IO ()
appendToBuffer cs email = do
  atomicModifyIORef' (csPendingBuf cs) (\buf -> (buf ++ [email], ()))

-- | Consumer loop with graceful shutdown
consumerLoop :: ConsumerState -> MessageQueue -> IO ()
consumerLoop cs queue = do
  state <- readIORef (csShutdown cs)
  case state of
    Stopped -> do
      flushBuffer cs
      putStrLn "Consumer stopped."
    Draining -> do
      -- Process remaining messages then stop
      drainRemaining cs queue
      writeIORef (csShutdown cs) Stopped
      flushBuffer cs
      putStrLn "Consumer drained and stopped."
    Running -> do
      msg <- readChan queue
      processMessage cs msg
      consumerLoop cs queue

-- | Drain remaining messages during shutdown
drainRemaining :: ConsumerState -> MessageQueue -> IO ()
drainRemaining cs queue = do
  -- Non-blocking drain attempt (simplified)
  return ()

-- | Flush the pending buffer (simulated send)
flushBuffer :: ConsumerState -> IO ()
flushBuffer cs = do
  buf <- readIORef (csPendingBuf cs)
  mapM_ (\email -> putStrLn $ "SENDING: " ++ take 200 email) buf
  writeIORef (csPendingBuf cs) []

-- | Initialize and run the consumer
main :: IO ()
main = do
  queue <- newChan
  shutdownRef <- newIORef Running
  processedRef <- newIORef 0
  bufRef <- newIORef []
  let cs = ConsumerState shutdownRef processedRef bufRef

  -- Simulate incoming messages
  let testMsg = QueueMessage
        { msgTo = "victim@example.com"
        , msgFrom = "sender@example.com"
        , msgSubject = "Hello"
        , msgBody = "Test body"
        , msgCustomHeaders = Map.fromList [("X-Queue-Id", "12345")]
        }
  writeChan queue testMsg

  -- Start consumer
  void $ forkIO $ consumerLoop cs queue
  threadDelay 100000
  writeIORef shutdownRef Draining
  threadDelay 200000
  n <- readIORef processedRef
  putStrLn $ "Processed: " ++ show n
